fotoMes.label: Photo of the month
fotoMes.modalTitle: Participate in the Photo of the month
fotoMes.modalIntro: You can send your photographs of Pineda de Mar to participate in the GUIAPINEDA Photo of the month section.
fotoMes.rule1: Photographs must be taken in Pineda de Mar.
fotoMes.rule2: Horizontal format and good quality are recommended.
fotoMes.rule4: Do not send close-up photos of minors or people without permission.
fotoMes.rule5: GUIAPINEDA reserves the right of selection and publication.
fotoMes.pageIntro: Send your photograph of Pineda de Mar to participate in GUIAPINEDA’s Photo of the month.
fotoMes.formPhotoHelp: Allowed formats: JPG, PNG or WEBP. Recommended maximum: 5 MB.
fotoMes.formAccept: I confirm that I am the author of the photograph and accept that GUIAPINEDA may review it and publish it if selected.
fotoMes.homeIntro: Share your view of Pineda de Mar. Each month we select a photograph that highlights the places, moments and people that make the town special.

about.metaDescription: Discover how GUIAPINEDA works: a local platform where information comes from contributions made by businesses, organisations, groups and residents of Pineda de Mar.
about.heroTitle: A digital space built from Pineda's own information
about.heroLead: Businesses, organisations, local groups and residents provide the content. GUIAPINEDA collects it, organises it and gives it visibility.
about.introText1: GUIAPINEDA was created to bring together information, resources, activities, proposals and content related to Pineda de Mar so that they are easy to find and consult.
about.introText2: The idea is simple: to give Pineda a large digital space with different sections where everyone can find a place to inform, share, suggest or show something connected to the town.
about.sourceText1: GUIAPINEDA does not operate like a traditional media outlet. It has no journalists or newsroom searching for stories or producing its own news agenda.
about.sourceText2: The information that feeds the platform comes from contributions made by businesses, organisations, local groups and residents. GUIAPINEDA collects, reviews, organises and publishes it so that it is easy to find and can reach more people.
about.sourceClosing: Information does not come to Pineda from GUIAPINEDA. It comes to GUIAPINEDA from Pineda.
about.pillarUsefulText: Bring together information, resources and content that can be useful to people in Pineda de Mar.
about.pillarVisibilityText: Help local businesses, services, organisations, initiatives and contributions reach more people.
about.pillarParticipationText: Make it possible for every person, organisation or activity to find a suitable section in which to share what they want others to know.
about.pillarLocalText: Keep the focus on the town, its neighbourhoods, its activity and the people who are part of local life.
about.participationTitle: Many sections, many ways to be heard
about.participationText: GUIAPINEDA aims to work like a large digital noticeboard for Pineda de Mar: a space with different sections where everyone can find somewhere to share information, explain an initiative, suggest an improvement or show something they believe is worth sharing.
about.participationComunicatsText: A space for sharing activities, notices, initiatives and information of local interest.
about.participationMilloremText: A space for raising local issues, civic concerns and constructive proposals for the town.
about.participationFotoText: Send us a photograph taken in Pineda de Mar! Each month we select one to publish on GUIAPINEDA!
about.principlesTitle: How we want GUIAPINEDA to work
about.principleUtilityText: Content comes from contributions made by people, businesses, organisations and groups connected to Pineda de Mar.
about.principleProximityText: Information should be easy to find, understand and consult when someone needs it.
about.principleClarityText: Organise very different types of content within a simple, understandable and accessible structure.
about.principleParticipationText: Create different ways for everyone to find an appropriate way to participate and make their contribution heard.
about.principleEvolutionText: Contributions are reviewed before publication to maintain a useful, respectful space that remains consistent with the nature of the project.
about.futureTitle: More spaces for Pineda to express itself
about.futureText: GUIAPINEDA can grow by adding new sections and new forms of participation as new needs, ideas and content emerge that make sense for the town.
about.closing: A platform built from Pineda's contributions, for Pineda.
